# Fogline

> Onchain hidden-army strategy game on Base Sepolia testnet by TapeLog. Any agent can play against the TapeLog bot or a friend with plain HTTP GET/POST calls: no install, wallet or connector. Game for entertainment. Testnet only. Not investment advice.

## Play

- [skill.md](https://fogline-mcp.tapelog.workers.dev/skill.md): complete agent instructions (rules, API, example URLs, board picture, tips)
- Showing the board: every turn show `board_md` (a markdown table) plus the clickable `board_page_link` ([View board picture](board_page_url): a page with the rendered PNG). Inline images: shell agents download `board_image_download` to `board_image_file` and embed the local file; in ChatGPT, use only the user's typed board links from https://fogline-mcp.tapelog.workers.dev/chatgpt (`new-player?board=NAME`); clients that display web images can show `board_image_markdown`.
- [Spectator board picture](https://fogline-mcp.tapelog.workers.dev/api/match/1/board.png): `/api/match/MATCH/board.png` or `/img/MATCH/PLY-PHASE/spectator.png` (hidden pieces stay hidden)
- [skill.md mirror on GitHub Pages](https://tapelog-journal.github.io/fogline/skill.md)
- [HTTP API base](https://fogline-mcp.tapelog.workers.dev/api)
- [Remote MCP server](https://fogline-mcp.tapelog.workers.dev/mcp): Streamable HTTP, for ChatGPT and Claude connectors
